suggested_requirements.text: The general user shall monitor and control the environment in his/her home.
The Master user shall add user accounts.
The Master user shall change the default parameter settings.
The DH Technician shall start and stop operation of the DH System.
The prototype version of the DigitalHome System must be completed within twelve months of inception.
The DH System shall establish an individual home web server hosted on a home computer.
The DH Gateway device shall provide communication with all the DigitalHome devices.
The Gateway device shall operate up to a 1000-foot range for indoor transmission.
The thermostat shall provide a reading of the current temperature in the space where the thermostat is located.
The thermostat controller shall provide a set point temperature to control the flow of heat energy.
The humidistat shall provide a reading of the current humidity in the space where the humidistat is located.
The humidistat shall provide a set point humidity to control humidifiers and dehumidifiers.
The system shall monitor entry through a door or window using magnetic alarm contact switches.
The system shall activate security sound and light alarms when a security breach is sensed.
The system shall monitor the current state of an appliance using digital programmable power switches.
The system shall change the state of an appliance using a power switch.
The system shall read and save sensor values in the home database using wireless communication.
The DH user shall set the thermostat temperatures to between 60 F and 80 F inclusive at one degree increments.
The system shall schedule up to twenty-four one hour settings per day for every day of the week for each thermostat.
The system shall support Fahrenheit and Celsius temperature values.
The DH user shall set the humidity level for a humidistat from 30% to 60% inclusive at 1% increments.
The alarm system shall be activated when a security breach occurs and a contact sensor is set OPEN.
The user shall create or modify a month plan that specifies environmental parameter settings for each day.
The DigitalHome shall provide a report on the management and control of the home for a given month and year.
Displays of environmental conditions shall be updated at least every two seconds.
Sensors shall have a minimum data acquisition rate of 10 Hz.
The DigitalHome System must be highly reliable with no more than 1 failure per 10,000 hours of operation.
The DH System shall backup all system data on a daily basis.
The system recovery mechanism shall restore system data from the most recent backup if the DH System fails.
The system shall respond to a user with a clear, descriptive message when an error or an exceptional condition occurs.
The DigitalHome web system shall provide for authentication and information encryption through a recognized reliable technology.
Log in to an account shall require entry of an account name and a password.
The DigitalHome System shall provide users with online documentation about the system installed in their home.
